question: What Does Urban Plates Offer for Thanksgiving 2026?
quick_answer: For Thanksgiving 2026, Urban Plates offers a chilled Turkey Feast for 6 to 8 people for $199.99, which must be pre-ordered by Sunday, November 22 for pickup on November 24 or 25. Hot, ready-to-eat options include a family meal for four for $114.99 and an individual turkey plate for $27.99, available November 24 to 26. Urban Plates restaurants are open on Thanksgiving Day, November 26, from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.
key_facts: Pre-order the feast by Sunday, Nov. 22
Hot family meal for 4: $114.99; turkey plate: $27.99

body.heading: The Turkey Feast
body.text: Urban Plates' main Thanksgiving package is the Turkey Feast, which serves 6 to 8 people and costs $199.99 in 2026. It includes herb-roasted turkey breast, mushroom stuffing, gravy, cranberry relish, bread and two sides. It comes fully cooked and chilled with reheating instructions, so you warm it up at home. Pre-orders close Sunday, November 22, and pickup is Tuesday, November 24 or Wednesday, November 25. One listing notes a surcharge on top of the price.

body.heading: Hot meals and turkey plates
body.text: If you'd rather not reheat anything, Urban Plates also sells hot, ready-to-eat Thanksgiving food from November 24 to 26. A family meal for four is $114.99, and a single turkey plate is $27.99, a good option for one or two people. In past years the turkey plate came with turkey breast, stuffing, gravy, cranberry relish, bread and a side.

body.heading: Is Urban Plates open on Thanksgiving?
body.text: Yes. Urban Plates restaurants are open on Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, November 26, 2026, from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. You can eat a turkey plate in the restaurant or pick up hot food that day, which is rare among Thanksgiving to-go options. Chilled feasts, however, are picked up before the holiday.

body.heading: How prices compare to past years
body.text: Urban Plates has offered a Thanksgiving menu for several years, and prices have climbed. Its family feast was $129 to $139 in the early 2020s, $175 in 2023 and is $199.99 in 2026. The turkey plate rose from about $19.95 to $27.99 over the same stretch. Sides and whole desserts have also been sold separately in past years; check the Thanksgiving page at urbanplates.com for this year's add-ons.

body.heading: How to order
body.text: Pre-orders are placed through Urban Plates' Thanksgiving page on its website. Urban Plates has locations across California, including San Diego, Orange County, Los Angeles and the Bay Area, and all locations take part. Order early, because the feast deadline comes before the holiday week. For everyday prices, see our Urban Plates menu.
